name: Sakamoto Kikutarou
source:
A Virgin Man Who Died While Masturbating in VR. He was a sex fiend even before his death and masturbated every day.

He’s generally socially awkward, but the skill’s effect makes him more assertive. He is reincarnated and acquires the 【Magical Sword】 skill.

[From [url=https://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc091/index.html]official site[/url]]
